title: Dog helps find missing owner, alerts lodge staff; rescuers find 69-year-old alive after freezing night
summary_full: Becky, the brave Basset hound, made her unexpected debut at a mountain lodge, alone and worried. Staff were quick to act, involving rescue teams equipped with drones and bloodhounds in the search for her missing owner. After enduring a frostbite-inducing night in the wilderness, he was located thanks to his loyal companion's timely arrival. Without Becky leading the way, the outcome could have been much grimmer for him.
